test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Different cells express different proteins depending on which promoters are either active or ________.
solution: The correct answer is **"dormant."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Dormant"** means inactive or asleep. (कुछ समय के लिए निष्क्रिय) • **Example**: *Authorities reopened a **dormant**__ investigation of the company.* • In the given sentence, the proteins expressed by cells depend on which promoters are active or inactive. • Grammatically, the word **"dormant" **is an adjective that describes the state of the promoters. • The correct answer is Option 1. **Correct sentence**: *Different cells express different proteins depending on which promoters are either active or __**dormant**__.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "effectual",** means effective or capable of producing a desired result. (वांछित परिणाम उत्पन्न करने में प्रभावी या सक्षम) • **Option 3, "productive"**, means yielding or producing results. (उत्‍पादित या उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला (विशेषतः बड़े परिणाम में); उत्‍पादनकारी) • **Option 4, "lazy"**, means unwilling to work or exert oneself. ((व्‍यक्ति) जो काम न करना चाहे; आलसी, कामचोर) 1da:T73b, Here, the erroneous part is **"and me works on my short."**
